subject: Conditional vendor allowlist + PO variance request: OpenProcure trial
messages:
From: Ari Tenenbaum <ari@openprocure.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@mirrorbank.com
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Quick: onboarding info + PO requirement question

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for taking the time on Friday. We filled out the onboarding form and attached a short bundle of security evidence (see attachment). A couple quick questions from our side:

- For the pilot we intend to run for 6 weeks, can we be onboarded on an invoice-only path (no PO) while we validate production traffic?
- If not, what evidence would accelerate a temporary allowance?

We anticipate ~$8k in spend for the pilot. Happy to jump on a 15-min call if helpful.

Best,
Ari
Founder | OpenProcure Inc.
Attachment: openprocure_onboarding_form_filled.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ari Tenenbaum <ari@openprocure.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: onboarding info + PO requirement question

Hi Ari — thanks for the packet. I looped in Sean (Procure) and Lauren (Finance ops) to get the right path.

Short answer: our standard onboarding requires a PO for vendor relationships once billing thresholds exceed $5k/month. That said, we have a temporary evidence-based exception for pilots where spend is under $10k total and specific controls are verified. To move fast we need:

1) Completed onboarding form (received)
2) SOC2 or equivalent attestation, or three security answers with supporting screenshots (you included some, but we need the attestation)
3) Billing contact and an internal approver listed on MirrorBank's side (procure@mirrorbank.com)

If those are in place, Finance can approve an invoice-only onboarding for the 6-week pilot with a PO waiver. Can you confirm SOC2 timeline or provide the extra controls screenshots?

If you prefer, we can do a short call tomorrow 8–8:30am PT.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Manager, Customer Onboarding | Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0123

Attachment referenced: onboarding checklist (stub)

Monica/Sean — thanks. Quick updates:

- We can provide a copy of our SOC2 Type II report under NDA.
- In the meantime I attached three screenshots of our access controls, encryption settings, and a recent vulnerability scan report (redacted).
- Billing contact at MirrorBank is billing@mirrorbank.com and their internal approver is Tara Ng (tara.ng@mirrorbank.com).

Would an NDA be sufficient to get the temporary invoice-only path approved while we route the SOC2? If so, we can e-sign today.

—Ari

Attachment: evidence_redacted_screenshots.pdf

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ari Tenenbaum <ari@openprocure.com>, procure@mirrorbank.com
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick: onboarding info + PO requirement question

Folks — after reviewing the materials and confirming MirrorBank's billing approver, Finance will approve a conditional invoice-only onboarding for the 6-week pilot subject to:

- NDA signed by OpenProcure (DocuSign link below)
- Receipt of SOC2 Type II within 45 days OR quarterly attestation signed by their security lead (we'll accept the SOC2 under NDA as equivalent)
- A one-time holdback clause on the first invoice until evidence is verified (standard language attached)

Lauren will issue the temporary vendor allowlist entry and notify Procurement ops to bypass the PO requirement for the pilot. Ari — please sign the NDA and reply with the DocuSign confirmation. Once signed we'll create the vendor record and route the invoice lane.

Lauren: please create the vendor allowlist entry under "Temp-Invoice-Pilot" and add D-2027-0789 to the deal notes.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Sr. Manager, Procurement | Redwood Inference
